essence: Saṃsāra is unreal for the embodied; bondage never truly is for anyone, so the liberation-rite is false. The error is a fourfold delusion-heap — rope, snake, shadow, ghost. Abandon nothing, grasp nothing; live healthy, staying.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is devotion (bhakti) in the mode of recognition (pratyabhijñā); the vyabhicāri is wonder (camatkāra) at bondage denied and the two prohibitions. The rasa is the tranquility of anupāya — no liberation-rite needed, just staying.
